gloss: natural trait; inherent quality; one's own

definitions.gloss: natural trait; inherent quality; innate characteristic
definitions.explanation: A quality, ability, or characteristic that someone naturally possesses. Almost always used in a positive sense to describe admirable traits that come naturally to a person.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{前|まえ}の{明|あか}るさで{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた。
examples.english: She got through it with her natural cheerfulness.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{持|も}ち{前|まえ}の{体力|たいりょく}で{最後|さいご}まで{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}いた。
examples.english: He ran all the way to the end with his natural stamina.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{前|まえ}の{行動力|こうどうりょく}を{活|い}かして、{新|あたら}しいプロジェクトを{成功|せいこう}させた。
examples.english: She leveraged her natural drive to action and made the new project a success.

notes:
Literally 'what one holds from before' — a quality that has been part of someone since birth or from a very early stage. Almost exclusively used in a positive or admiring context to describe desirable traits. Typically used as a modifier in the pattern {持|も}ち{前|まえ}の + [positive trait].

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持|も}ち{前|まえ}の{明|あか}るさ: natural cheerfulness
- {持|も}ち{前|まえ}の{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}さ: innate perseverance
- {持|も}ち{前|まえ}の{体力|たいりょく}: natural stamina
- {持|も}ち{前|まえ}の{行動力|こうどうりょく}: natural drive to act
- {持|も}ち{前|まえ}のセンス: natural sense/flair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生|う}まれつき: innate, from birth — can describe both positive and negative traits; more neutral
- {天性|てんせい}: natural disposition — more literary; emphasizes heaven-given talent
- {素質|そしつ}: natural aptitude — focuses on latent ability rather than observable traits
